title: Commanders to sign Van Jefferson to practice squad

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Commanders to sign Van Jefferson to practice squad
sources.description: Wide receiver Van Jefferson did not make the cut to the 53-man roster in Washington, but he's rejoining the Commanders ahead of their season opener.
